title: Chapter 6857: Don’T Ask About The Future

Chapter 6857: Don’T Ask About The Future

Chapter 6857: Don’t Ask About The Future

“I’m dead.” After a long silence, the face remarked.

A weight was lifted off his shoulders as everything became clear.

“Confronting death and bidding goodbye to the past. I won’t live forever, no one else can, and I am not special.” He continued.

“It is fortunate to be able to bid farewell after death.” Li Qiye said.

“I’ve been unwilling all this time after death.” He said.

“Your dao heart is still alive.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, and this should be the end of it.” He said sentimentally: “What about you?”

“There will be a day when I die. I am waiting for it without fear.” Li Qiye said.

“Waiting for it, I see.” He finally smiled after a long time: “I wonder if there is a next life, and what it would look like for me.”

“Should you be wondering?” Li Qiye asked.

“I suppose not, the past and the present are finished. The future has yet to begin, so there’s no point wondering.” He said.

“Indeed.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Thank you for helping me accept death and safeguard my dao heart. Otherwise, my future would have been rather ugly.” He stared at Li Qiye carefully before speaking.

“It is what should be done.” Li Qiye said.

“Farewell for good, friend.” He closed his eyes and the gigantic face began to sink, disappearing from the death section.

“Buzz.” Light flowed from the deepest area of the death section. It seemed to have been hidden beneath all the death.

Today, death and its darkness couldn’t press this light down any longer. It illuminated death and changed it to life water instead, identical to the liquid seen in the life section.

Thus, Heaventrove Mountain had two life sections henceforth. The border protected by the tribulations also disappeared and the two sections fused as one.

The special light began floating in the air, looking like a celestial beating heart.

“It’s beautiful.” Thunder Emperor couldn’t help but praise.

“Go.” Li Qiye flicked his finger and the light crossed through dimensions and time.

“Pop!” It entered an unknown area and melted like snow, virtually imperceptible to others.

“Boom!” With Xian Shen gone, all the illusions also collapsed.

Li Qiye’s group teleported back to the broken world with the twelve palaces.

Heaventrove Mountain lost balance and life water gushed down like a flood, drowning everything. The destroyed world began absorbing it.

The pierced mountains, broken continents, and dried oceans took in the water. Life began once more.

Seeds and tiny lifeforms sprouted in the blink of an eye. Destruction and silence were no more; prosperity was only a matter of time.

“A new world is being born.” Thunder Emperor said.

“To be more accurate, Xian Shen is returning this to the world. When the obsession with life is gone, life will return. It has always been there, just changed into death.” Li Qiye said.

“Life was always there?” She found this surprising.

“Of course, where do you think the life of Stygian is?” Li Qiye asked.

“Devoured by the alliance.” She said.

“Yes, but it didn’t disappear.” He smiled.

“Just have to deal with the alliance then.” The bear said.

“And that is when I need you.” Li Qiye tapped his shoulder and said.

“Me?” The bear pointed at his nose: “I can’t handle that much.”

“Don’t worry, you can’t kill all of them. I just need you to call all of them.” Li Qiye said.

“How would I do that?” The bear asked.

“You will understand soon enough, just follow the instructions and watch the show.” Li Qiye smirked.

“Just command me, Young Noble.” The bear had a good idea.
